name: MD Jariful Rahman
headline: Backend-focused Software Developer with full-stack capabilities. I build clean, reliable APIs and resilient background workflows—emphasizing disciplined architecture and pragmatic, end-to-end delivery.
summary: Software engineer graduating from University of Dhaka (IIT) with hands-on industry experience at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd. I specialize in building type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data layers, and asynchronous worker systems, pairing disciplined engineering with end-to-end delivery.
availability: Open to Full-Time Backend & Software Developer Roles

about.sectionDescription: My journey, engineering principles, practical craft, and future technical trajectory.

steps.label: Foundations & Experience
steps.title: Software Engineering at DU (IIT) & Industry Track Record
steps.description: I completed my Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering (BSSE) coursework at the University of Dhaka (Institute of Information Technology). My focus has always been hands-on: understanding systems from first principles and building complete projects from database schemas to responsive interfaces. During my 6-month software engineering tenure at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd, I worked directly on automated testing (Appium, WebdriverIO), API performance load testing, and production web application delivery.

steps.label: Engineering Mindset
steps.title: Modular Architecture, Proper Data Modeling & Reliability
steps.description: I believe that code is read and maintained far more often than it is written. My approach emphasizes clean separation of concerns, thoughtful database normalization and indexing before writing queries, and designing for failure recovery from the start. Rather than applying quick patches that accumulate technical debt, I strive to write predictable, well-structured software with automated test coverage.

steps.label: Core Craft
steps.title: Type-Safe APIs, Asynchronous Workflows & Full-Stack Execution
steps.description: My core sweet spot is backend engineering with Python (FastAPI) and Node.js (Express), paired with relational data stores like PostgreSQL. I enjoy building asynchronous worker daemons and resilient multi-step workflow systems that handle long-running operations outside the request-response cycle. In addition, I containerize multi-service applications using Docker and bridge backend services with clean frontends using Next.js and React.

steps.label: Future Trajectory
steps.title: Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Queues & Modern DevOps
steps.description: Looking ahead, I am actively expanding into distributed systems architectures, event-driven streaming, and deeper DevOps practices—including automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and resilient cloud deployments. I am eager to bring this disciplined, end-to-end mindset to ambitious engineering teams and impactful software products.
